# phasetwo_cluster (Data Source)

An existing dedicated cluster.

Give exactly one of `id` or `name`. Archived clusters are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phasetwo_cluster" "existing" {
  name = "acme-prod"
}

output "cluster_host" {
  value = data.phasetwo_cluster.existing.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the cluster. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the cluster. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `domain` (String) Custom domain recorded at provision time.
- `host` (String) Base URL of the cluster's Keycloak instance.
- `owner` (String) ID of the owning organization.
- `region` (String) Region the cluster runs in.
- `resource_limits` (String) `standard` or `custom`.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `tier` (String) Subscription tier.
- `variant` (String) `DEDICATED` or `SHARED`.
